name: devex-rates
description: Roblox Developer Exchange (DevEx) rates: the three rates in force today, every rate change on record, and the payout minimum. Maintained by LootTally.

license.attribution: DevEx rate data by LootTally (loottally.com), CC BY 4.0

processing_business_days.note: Plus the receiving bank's own processing time.

rates.label: Standard
rates.applies_to: All Earned Robux, unless it qualifies for the U.S. 18+ rate or sits in a pre-September 2025 balance.

rates.label: U.S. 18+
rates.applies_to: Earned Robux from developer products, passes, subscriptions and private servers bought by U.S. players who verified they are 18+, in an experience that meets the R15 character requirements.

rates.label: Legacy
rates.effective_from_note: Standard rate until September 5, 2025 at 10am PT
rates.applies_to: Earned Robux balances held before September 5, 2025 at 10am PT. These cash out first, before any Robux earned at the current rate.

history.headline: DevEx launches
history.detail: Roblox opens the Developer Exchange, letting qualifying creators convert Earned Robux into real currency once a month.

history.headline: Rate rises to $0.0035
history.detail: The payout rate moves from $0.0025 to $0.0035 per Earned Robux, where it stays for the next eight years.

history.headline: Standard rate rises to $0.0038
history.detail: Effective 10am PT. Balances earned before this moment keep the $0.0035 rate and must be cashed out first.

history.headline: U.S. 18+ rate introduced at $0.0054
history.detail: A third rate, not a replacement. It applies only to spend from age-verified 18+ U.S. players on developer products, passes, subscriptions and private servers, in experiences that meet the R15 character requirements.

legacy_balance: Old-rate balances must be cashed out before any Robux earned at the current rate. This includes one-time payouts from groups.
Spending Robux on the platform does not clear your old-rate balance. Spending deducts from your total balance, but it does not count toward clearing the previous-rate Earned Robux first.
us18_experience_requirements: Players must spend 100% of active playtime as an R15 platform avatar, with no R6 spawning or switching
Custom human-form characters need roughly 1 head, 2 arms and 2 legs, 12 limb parts or joints distributed evenly, a torso with at least 2 parts or joints, and full bipedal range of motion
Animation packs must be R15, not R6
